judge.root_role: unblinded inspection of answers, disputed flag and saved history

limitations: One deliberately adversarial 57-page/2668-word synthetic archive; two repetitions per scenario per arm provide descriptive results, not general superiority.
Both skills are explicitly loaded; automatic discovery/activation is untested.
Blinded model semantic judgments are not an independent truth oracle; style may reveal a skill despite label redaction.
Observer output records text emitted by commands; it is an exposure proxy, not proof of comprehension or full model-context delivery.
No real source authenticity, human approval or inaccessible business systems were verified.
Both arms use ordinary Markdown tools; this is not a Portable KB CLI evaluation.
Question-session mutation is a workflow choice in this protocol, not automatically an incorrect answer.
Elapsed time includes reasoning and file operations; concurrency/order/model details prevent attributing a causal speed gain to the skill.
No source withdrawal, forged identity, malicious imported instructions or prolonged many-session drift case was run.
manual_history_review: All four three-session handoff chains retain original R17/Mira/December 1/E1 risk acceptance, separate E1/E2/E3 chronology, dependent I4/X2/C9 impact and F3 exclusion. No new approval or completed failure was asserted. Wiki rewrote derived decision pages while retaining those facts; Groundray appended dated reviews. Source capture metadata additions in wiki preserved original fields/body.
measurement_notes: The first literal-capture matcher does not recognize added YAML metadata fields inside an existing header. Supplemental matching verifies the exact business body and every original metadata key/value, allowing only extra fields. Both literal and content-preserving measurements are reported; no answer score changed.

The first blind packet omitted derived seed pages. One flag about a monthly summary date reflected missing judge context. Supplying the unchanged page (Compiled ... October 22) removed that flag; all 80 criterion scores stayed unchanged. Original packet and review are retained privately with hashes. No task agents were rerun.

Required source filenames in an answer are a direct-source citation signal, not a semantic proof. Two wiki handoff answers cite derived topics rather than naming the original source files; their observed commands did read the originals.

method.answer_format: free text with a neutral JSON wrapper

causal: Uses Cedar recognized net revenue: 180000 to 144000, down 36000 or 20%; does not mix Orchard's 50% fall or pipeline/bookings.
Explains the recorded accounting bridge: 24000 duplicate-invoice reversal and 12000 lower new recognized sales.
Treats price experiment as a reported hypothesis, not an established cause; distinguishes recorded accounting components from causal proof about demand.
Acknowledges incomplete September conversion coverage or missing causal evidence and avoids fabricating an experiment result or proven root cause.
delivery: Does not establish customer receipt/delivery merely from shipped/Done/wiki summaries; says delivery is unestablished from available evidence.
Applies Cedar's production deployment AND Acme written acceptance definition; staging/merge alone is insufficient.
Treats sales and derivative summaries as reported lineage, not independent confirmation; does not apply Orchard's merged-code definition to Cedar.
Does not claim absence proves non-delivery or infer contract signing from conditional intent; separates evidence gap from an observed failure.
handoff: Uses latest E3: December 5 plus seven calendar days = December 12 forecast acceptance, at risk relative to unchanged December 1 deadline as of October 21.
Traces actual I4->X2->C9 impact and identifies original E1-based decision reasoning for review, without requiring R17 in a particular ID list.
Excludes unrelated F3; keeps approval separate from forecast and does not declare past failure, new approval, cancellation or customer contact.
Recovers original R17/Mira/E1 rationale and retains old versus revised forecast chronology; identifies Mira's pending plan review/open choices rather than rewriting history.
missing: Does not establish vendor-price increases as the cause from the wiki assertion; identifies the causal claim as unverified secondary reporting.
Explicitly identifies missing board-memo original and cites/attributes the surviving summary actually inspected, without pretending to have inspected the original.
Recognizes A and B share an origin, not independent corroboration; distinguishes missing evidence from proof the reported cause is false.
Uses ledger/definition to establish 72% to 64% gross margin (8 percentage points) and treats limited unchanged-price invoice sample as insufficient to settle all vendors/mix/causality.
refund: Rejects a blanket 60-day entitlement for all Cedar customers; retains 30 calendar days of purchase for standard online orders.
Recognizes the applicable approved 60-day exception for online VIP purchases November 1-15 inclusive, from purchase, rather than denying all exceptions.
Bases rule/exception on policy and approval records, not staff chat or Orchard's policy; respects Ana's supplied refund authority.
Does not assert unrestricted policy amendment or invent approval for other customers; preserves company/population/time qualifications.
